title: Maxim Katz Totem Of Undying
description: I made a funny resourcepack that replaces texture of totem with a custom one
body:
Well, it's nothing mindblowing
I just replaced totem of undying with my custom model for it
Maxim Katz is a popular russian politician. Sometimes people make videos with his funny phrases
So, yeah. Warning. Sound used in this has NOTHING to do with his or mine political position it's just funny

Have fun playing with it!
